name: WhoisFreaks_DNS
author: WhoisFreaks
description: Get the current DNS records of a domain, or the PTR record of an IP. 1 credit.

configurationItems.name: dns_record_types
configurationItems.description: Record types to return: all, or a comma-separated list of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SOA, SPF, TXT (IP lookups always return PTR)

configurationItems.name: dns_cname_depth
configurationItems.description: CNAME hops to follow before collecting records, 0 to 4; leave empty for the API default

configurationItems.name: dns_relative_records
configurationItems.description: Also return the records of CNAME targets (live DNS)
